title: Mixed Event — Connected Through SEKAI's Cherry Blossoms

meta.Outline: In the Empty SEKAI, Miku's words inspire a discussion among Kanade and the others about having a cherry blossom viewing party. Meanwhile, everyone in the other SEKAI is also planning ways to make the most of the season...

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm done coloring...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh wow. That's really good...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It is.
You've improved so much.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But there's not much else to do.
Coloring is fun and all, but it's not something you can do forever...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
In that case...
How about cat's cradle?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm not against it...
But I'm looking for something more... Exciting...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Exciting...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What are you planning now, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Plan?
Do I really seem like the scheming type?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, very.
Why not just read a book if you're that bored?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Read...?
Are you reading anything, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Fashion and travel magazines.
Mizuki left all of these here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh? Anything interesting...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A few things.
It helps me understand the world outside this one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you must've gone through those a few times now. Aren't you tired of reading them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That's a yes...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya!
How's it going?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good.
All of you seem well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, for the most part.
But never a dull moment, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I'm still kind of bored.
Isn't there something fun we can do?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Fun?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Luka, you're doing it again...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
It's not urgent, really.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But you're all here together...
Does that mean your next song is ready?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, that's right. We brought a new demo over to listen to together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Aren't you curious as to what it's like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I am...
Alright, let me put this away first.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, you colored in the drawings I brought. Can I take a look at some later?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: O-Okay, sure...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO, you've been reading the zines I brought over! What did you think?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They were pretty interesting...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Things become so much livelier whenever they come over.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Can we listen to the demo now...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
Let's hear it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play it now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyone else think this is gonna be another really good one? It's kinda quiet but has this way of creeping into your heart, you know...?
bgm_area00005

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I agree!
It really knows how to creep up on you!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What did you think, Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It was nice. It felt warm...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It did...?
I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How about you, Miku? The rest of you too. I'd like to hear about anything you felt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I... I thought it was good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Not bad, I guess?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No comment as usual...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO. Always playing hard to get. I for one thought it was a lovely and well-refined song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
In that case, I'll try sticking with what I have.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I'll need to get started on my rough draft! What kinds of motifs do you think will work best?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, there's still practically nothing here. I'm gonna be hard-pressed for ideas at this rate...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's all cherry blossoms and beautiful views on our side, so there's like nothing in between, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But this place is kinda nice once you get used to it since there's so much space.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I get that...
But one cherry blossom tree could do this place wonders.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A cherry blossom tree...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Have you never seen one before, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, only petals. Kanade showed me before...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You got to see the ones Ms. Mochizuki brought over.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes.
But I've never seen a big cherry blossom tree before...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right...
I know. Why don't we show you the next time we go to a park?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's fun to catch the petals as they fall from their branches!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's so hard too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
But we wouldn't be able to catch any petals in your world...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right... You'd be a hologram... Is there anything we can do about that?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We could bring some branches over.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What...?!
You're not planning on breaking some off, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Flower shops usually carry them...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I thought she meant buying some too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
G-Geez, you had me going there...!
Your tone made it sound like you were thinking about ripping some off a poor tree, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha!
You definitely have a talent for jumping to the wrong conclusion, Ena♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Alright, why don't we go buy some for them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Wanna get a bunch and have a little picnic under our cherry blossoms?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, wait.
We should make it a big party!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, I don't have a problem with that, but we'll have to go get juice and snacks...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
That could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Catching petals as they fall does sound challenging, but I agree that it could be fun.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Petals...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The cherry blossom tree we saw during that mystery tour literally rained petals down upon us...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
I still remember how pretty you thought they were, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember how that doll appeared here that one time? Could the same happen with a cherry blossom tree?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What? I doubt a tree's just gonna pop up here...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But this is SEKAI we're talking about. It's a place born from everyone's feelings, so it's not out of the question.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That may be so, but you're talking about a whole tree suddenly sprouting from the ground.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, we should head back soon!
We can talk more about our party once we're done working on everything else♪

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
We'll need to get some branches...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Stay tuned, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's gone all quiet again.
But I'm looking forward to seeing some actual cherry blossoms.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Honestly...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (A cherry blossom party with everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember how that doll appeared here that one time? Could the same happen with a cherry blossom tree?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu even said cherry blossoms are so beautiful...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (That doll was a manifestation of her feelings, so maybe...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I might go take a look around...
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I keep walking, but there's nothing here...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Haven't any cherry blossom trees appeared yet...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Hmm...
I might try looking more over there.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Still nothing...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (After walking around this much too...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I think I'm getting tired.
Time for a break...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There really aren't any cherry blossom trees... But not just trees...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There's nothing here...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There used to be even less here.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (In the beginning, it was just Mafuyu and me in this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It was just a white, empty space...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But Mafuyu kept making music despite everything she was going through.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And after that...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You've been waiting? Then you know who we are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously?
Does that mean you're the one who brought us here?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way. So this isn't like a dream or something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Kanade, Ena and Mizuki came along...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (This SEKAI has Kanade and the others now...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also...
You want to help her that much?
Then allow me to join you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Rin was the first to arrive...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there are also things you become blind to by getting too close...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'd like to maintain my distance and observe them for now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And the others soon followed.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's nice to finally meet you all.
Miku's told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (They all show it in different ways, but they care about Mafuyu and the others very much...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (More and more people began appearing in this SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's become a little livelier than before.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu's begun to change a little bit at a time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad for you, Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: My chest... It feels warm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This feeling... Am I happy...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (There may not be any cherry blossom trees, but I have everyone else here with me...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (So I'm happy as long as I'm able to spend time with them.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm glad I went looking for one like this since it led me to this realization...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to keep doing what I can for everybody moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(I should head back soon...
Rin and the others will start worrying if I'm away for too long.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh...?
There's something sparkling on the ground.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Is this a fragment of a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (A fragment of a feeling... Someone's feelings that are yet to become its own SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (SEKAI are born out of people's feelings, but not all of these feelings can turn into SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (As a result, some feelings appear in this form from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (And it's possible to see some of this person's feelings by touching it.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (What could this one entail...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (It's glowing... But I haven't touched it yet...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: S-So bright...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Is this a field...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(...?
Wait, there's something in the air...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Cherry blossom petals...?
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ready, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes!
Everyone's all here!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Great! Then, let's start our brainstorming session for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
This is going to be so fun with all of us here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Why don't we get right down to our ideas? Any thoughts regarding our next show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Well, I think it should be a really fun and exciting show!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Fun and exciting...?
Yeah, it'd be nice to put on a show that made the fans and us all feel that way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: At the same time, we should probably choose a theme of some sort. That'll probably help us make this show as fun as it can be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right. Choosing a theme should also allow us to work out the finer details, all of which will be important in terms of putting on a good show.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Speaking of which, aren't Minori and the girls always saying that it's important to pick a theme when coming up with stream ideas?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, let's start by picking a theme...! Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Just in the nick of time♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, everyone's on stage today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're right!
Their aura's so bright when they're all together...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, girls!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Why don't you join us on stage?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, thanks.
What were you discussing just now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We were just talking about what kind of theme we should pick for our next show!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Should we go? Are we interrupting...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, not at all!
We'd love to hear your opinions as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that'd be nice.
What do you say? Do you have some time to stick around...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We'd love to help!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Minori!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I know this is a bit sudden, but got any good ideas?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... A theme that can help make a show fun and exciting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You can look at this a lot of different ways...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, how about something that feels seasonal...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It's spring now...
So how about a “Spring Show”...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
A spring show?
That sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, spring...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a season that's all about sprouting and growth, so we could do a show that lets everyone see “a new side of us”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Look at you, Len.
You wrapped everything up with a nice bow♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Thank you all so much!
I think we have our theme now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We're always glad to be of service.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, we'll be doing a spring show where we'll be showing everyone “a new side of us”!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can't wait to see it...!
I bet it's gonna be a really exciting show!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori.
We'll be doing everything we can to make sure everyone enjoys it!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, why don't we start hammering out some of the details? What would you all like to do during our spring show?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
What if we had cherry blossom petals rain down everywhere?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Petals?
Yes, that'd be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know, right?
Minori told me about this time she sang under some cherry blossom trees, so I wanna try doing it too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You did, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh... You mean that time?
She's talking about when I sang under these cherry blossom trees with a couple of friends from school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was a lot of fun, and those trees were so pretty!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
Cherry blossoms are perfect for the stage and make it just that much more fun to sing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I like that idea too.
Cherry blossoms falling from the sky would make everything feel so romantic...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'd love to see that too!
It'll be an amazing spectacle!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But... I kinda want an actual tree there during the show and not just petals...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A cherry blossom tree?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Wouldn't it be even more romantic if we had an actual tree on stage?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're talking about a real tree...?
That means we'd have to carry one over somehow, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! My guess is that there are so many stages around here that there's bound to be one with a cherry blossom tree!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see your point, but I have a feeling we would've found it by now if it's really out there...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah...
It's a great idea, Rin, but I'm not sure if we can really put it into practice.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, let's go look for it...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If we don't find one, we can just go with flower petals alone. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, we'll help too!
Let's go find that tree!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No...
Not a single one...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All these stages but no trees.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To be fair, it's not exactly common for idols to have a tree standing in the middle of their stage during shows.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As unfortunate as it is, we may have to give up on this idea.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to do a show our way in addition to your other show...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There might not be any cherry blossom trees here, but I thought that it'd be nice to do an after-show over there while having a little picnic.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we'll need to be discrete so that no one sees what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, really...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's an incredible idea.
It'd be great to give that a try.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! I'll throw some food together for us!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'll help.
Hehe. I'm sure it'll be a lovely picnic.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thanks a bunch...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Good for you, Rin♪
Alright, why don't we start preparing for it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, let's!
Stay tuned, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if we had some cherry blossoms appear on the rear display?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We could even use pink lights to make everything feel more spring-like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Everyone's being so nice about this.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (For their sake, I have to make sure this show goes well!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I still think it'd be better to have an actual cherry blossom tree on stage...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh...?
There's something sparkly backstage...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What could it be? Did a light fall down or something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's round and shiny...
Oh, is it one of the new lights that KAITO was talking about?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It looks hot. Maybe I can prod it with... Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
It's a fragment of a feeling!
Eep!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Heya!
I came to hang out, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Len, welcome.
You're here later than usual.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...? Oh no!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The gang's all here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come sit with us, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, what's going on?
Is something happening today?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO and Rin called us in when we were passing by the cafe just now to try these new menu items.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ That's what's up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
New menu items?
Oh, these pink drinks...?!
And this looks like a dessert...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Those are cherry blossom lattes and smoothies. KAITO's having some pancakes topped with cherry blossom ice cream.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wow, that looks delicious...!
I wanna try some too! Um... I'll have what Luka's having!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A cherry blossom latte?
Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But no one told me that you'd come up with some new menu items, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course not. I just started making these the other day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I drew some inspiration from one of the photos Kohane showed me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?
What kind of photo was it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A budding cherry blossom.
The way it was just starting to turn pink was so beautiful that I felt compelled to make some drink based on that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! You can come up with new menu items just like that?! Way to go, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. But I don't deserve all the credit. Rin helped out as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I came up with a bunch of ideas for her, like how they should look and stuff! Outside of that... I was sort of the taste tester.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see.
Not only do these look nice, but they're pink in a spring-like way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, exactly!
They're aesthetically pleasing and delicious!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's hard not to get excited about spring♪ Thank you both for making these, MEIKO, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. We did it, MEIKO! High five!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for helping me with these, Rin.

rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI's about to disappear...

They really startled me there...
I wasn't expecting to see all of them here like this.
I take it that their individual desires to help everyone ended up tying them together.
Hehe.
Good luck, everyone. And please keep watching over them...
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Groan*
Huh? I'm on stage...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: W-Wait, I was just...? Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm? Rin?
What are you doing sleeping up there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll catch a cold at this rate! Don't you know taking care of your body is a part of being an idol?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: N-No, I wasn't sleeping!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I saw a fragment of a feeling backstage and was sent to this big field with this strange tree after touching it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And I saw you guys there too!
Oh, I don't mean you personally since they looked totally different!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, slow down. You're giving us too much info all at once. What do you mean you saw us but not us personally...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-That's the thing! I saw Len and MEIKO but they weren't you guys...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, could it be that you saw the versions of us from different SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But nothing like that has ever happened before...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm...
So was I just seeing things...?
bgm_area00003
Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO, wake up!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Mhm...
Huh? Are we back in our SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When did we get sent back?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO, did you happen to make eye contact with the others? You know, the ones who looked just like Rin and Miku?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, them...?
I definitely remember thinking that they looked just like them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right?! What do you think happened just now?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've been able to see people's feelings through these fragments before, but never anything like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Was that place some sort of nexus between SEKAI...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Can a place like that really exist...?)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Do you think we can see it again?!
That fragment might still be there...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I think it's gone...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, what was that place...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It was really strange...
But I felt really happy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I went out looking for a cherry blossom tree as a way to put a smile on everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So I'm really glad that I was able to show at least you some cherry blossom petals, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Yes, they were certainly beautiful.
Let's hope next time that we all get to see them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO? Len?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Wait, I know! You're both lost, right?
Looks like I have no choice but to lead you back to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Len & MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, we're not.
We're not lost.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(What I saw just now...
It was only for a second, but I thought I saw the others. Except, they looked very different...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Does that mean they're from other SEKAI...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I've seen fragments of other people's feelings appear in SEKAI before.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (But none have ever allowed me to see the others from different SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Was that some sort of special fragment...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, are the feelings that let me go to that place...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, there you are...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
KAITO...
You came looking for me? Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Um... I went out looking for you with Miku and the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were thinking about playing something for the girls as thanks for getting our picnic together...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
Alright, let's go practice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Luka...?
Did something nice happen to you just now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I'd say so...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (I can't show everyone the cherry blossoms I saw, but I at least have a nice story to tell them...)
bgm_area00004
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: KAITO! Thank goodness...!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
We're so glad you're back!
Especially since our present made you disappear...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry about causing such a stir. There, there now. I'm back safe and sound...

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: KAITOOO!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I thought I saw Miku and the others... But from different SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (However, I've never been able to meet anyone from another SEKAI before... What happened...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Unless, it's because...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Our feelings all came together to bring about that place...?)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I can't honestly explain how that works, but it could be similar to when everyone showed up here...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Just as their feelings brought them here, my feelings aligning with the others' allowed me to see them.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
But... What kind of feelings...?
Oh, wait...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I see.
Us all gathering at that tree means...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The ones from the other SEKAI also want to “help everyone somehow” very much.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
KAITO!
Everyone gathered up some cherry blossom petals for us!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, I'll be right there!
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm back in my usual SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, there you are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Rin...
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cat's cradle...
It's so boring when you don't have a playmate.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway, what are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Um... I was looking for something.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You were? Did you find what you were looking for...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No.
But something strange happened along the way...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Miku, there's something on your head.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
My head...?
Oh, this...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a cherry blossom petal...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guess I managed to find myself a cherry blossom petal.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, where?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. About that...
